proposition: the locket was her mother's and she was entrusted to keep it safe
quote: She said, simply, "It was my mother's. On her deathbed she put it into my hand and told me, \"Keep the heart she loved safe.\""

proposition: Thomas will keep the locket and not show it to anyone
quote: "I will keep it, Miss Evelyn," he said, "I will not show it to anyone."
